main.description: List a community's standing bans, in force and lapsed, newest indexed first. Only the community's owner and moderators and instance admins may list them.

limit.description: Maximum number of bans to return

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous page

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: Authentication is required; sign in before retrying.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is neither a moderator of the community nor an instance admin, or the community is not hosted here or is removed.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: community is not a DID, limit is out of range or cursor is malformed.

errors.name: ModerationUnavailable
errors.description: The moderation service is temporarily unavailable; retry later.

output.description: A page of the community's bans

cursor.description: Cursor of the next page; absent on the last page

ban.description: One standing ban record in the community's repo

reason.description: The ban's reason; absent when it has none

expiresAt.description: When the ban ends; absent for a permanent ban

createdAt.description: The ban record's createdAt, when known

indexedAt.description: When this instance indexed the ban record

active.description: True while the ban is in force: it has no expiry or its expiry is in the future
